info.title: POTHIK OTA API
info.description: REST API for the POTHIK online travel agency. All endpoints are versioned under /api/v1 and return the envelope `{ success, message, data, meta? }` on success or `{ success: false, message, code, errors? }` on failure. Authenticate with a Bearer access token; permissions are enforced centrally by role and resource ownership is checked in the service layer. Generate a static copy with `npm run openapi` in backend/.
